title: Posture Break Timer
description: A desk-worker timer that nudges you to stand, stretch and fix your posture on a schedule you set.
howto: Choose how often you want a posture break.
Press Start and keep working — the countdown runs in the tab.
When it fires, stand, stretch and reset your posture; breaks are counted for today.

faqs.q: How often should I take a posture break?
faqs.a: Every 30 minutes is the common recommendation: stand, roll your shoulders, and look away from the screen for a minute.

faqs.q: What should I do during the break?
faqs.a: Stand up, stretch your chest and hip flexors, roll your neck gently, and reset your sitting posture when you sit back down.
Yes — it tracks breaks per calendar day in this browser.
